note: Alpha ladder of the Qwen3.5-9B editing policy (writes K edit instructions) trained with GRPO against Qwen-Image-2512, training update 750. Rung N serves that LoRA adapter at scale N/100 (0 to 2); the slider covers 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05 and the alpha box goes up to 2. Adapters: neulab/t-dig/qwen-image-2512/9b-edit (the released checkpoint there is update 650, chosen by the rule in its README; the ladder the paper's interactive study served used update 750). Build the rungs with scripts/build_alpha_ladders.sh.
